description: Free, no sign-in. Use when someone asks which landlord licensing schemes an English council runs, or when no postcode is known. Returns every scheme for the council with its wards, dates, fees, consultations and council sources, and the council's lettance.com page. Pass a slug such as 'southwark' or a name such as 'Birmingham'. Read-only. A council we have not researched yet returns researched: false with its region and landlord register window; that is unknown coverage, not no licence needed.
